All members of the Guideline Development Group (GDG) and the chemical and microbial working groups (WGs) completed WHO declaration of interest forms. These forms were reviewed by the secretariat to identify potential conflicts of interest (COI). While several COIs were declared, none necessitated the exclusion of any GDG or WG member from their respective roles.
